typeProperties.script:
source(output(
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FFMINDOULAEXCLUDE
FFMINDOULAEXCLUDE derive(SBSB_ID = SBSB_ID) ~> PlaceHolderCNTTotal
PlaceHolderCNTTotal derive(MarketName = 'LA',
		GRGR_CK = 28,
		SBSB_ID = rtrim(toString(ltrim(toString(SBSB_ID),' ')),' ')) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		MarketName as string,
		GRGR_CK as integer,
		SBSB_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		MarketName,
		GRGR_CK,
		SBSB_ID)) ~> OLEDBMindoulaSMIMembersLKP
